description.fun: Luvdisc is a symbol of love: couples gave it its name after spotting it in the sea, any couple who sees one is said to be blessed with eternal love, and honeymoon hotels release them into their pools. In breeding season, their swarms turn the sea pink. Left alone, though, a Luvdisc loses heart and becomes easy prey. It was once overfished because of a rumour that its scales help you find a sweetheart.
description.guide: A Water-type Pokémon shaped like a heart and based on discus fish, living in warm, shallow seas and nesting among coral. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A heart-shaped fish said to bless couples with eternal love
